title: Ghosted (KINO)
synopsis:
An extraordinary love story between two worlds: Hamburg artist Sophie travels to Taiwan to come to terms with the sudden, unexplained death of her lover Ai-ling. In Taipei, a journalist latches onto her heels, seemingly obsessed with Ai-ling's fate. At the same time, the mysterious stranger does everything in her power to seduce Sophie.

 

Inspired by Taiwan's rapid social and technological development alongside ancient Chinese culture, Monika Treut weaves a narrative that drifts between past and present. At its core lie Chinese ghost myths, where traditionally oppressed women become erotic, daring beings who finally follow their own desires, and thus also find a way to take revenge.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 漢堡藝術家蘇菲來到台北，試圖走出戀人愛玲突然離世的陰霾。記者美麗如影隨形地跟蹤她，對愛玲的命運異常執著，同時亦引誘傷痛中的蘇菲。莫妮卡楚特首部合拍劇情長片，以鬼魂神話為靈感，長期受壓迫的女性在幽冥之間化身為大膽、充滿慾望的存在，終於得以追尋自身的渴望。故事過去與現在之間游走，鋪陳一段撲朔迷離的女女曖昧。
